products.title: Siux Street 2026 Violet Backpack - Siux
products.description:
SIUX STREET 2026 BACKPACK - A padel backpack with a unique design. This style is perfect for storing a racket comfortably, as well as your basic equipment to enjoy this sport. The new SIUX STREET 2026 BACKPACK comes with a clearly different proposal, with a more urban style. It stands out for its roll-up design, known as "Roll-top". It provides a more daring look, but it is also great because it allows you to adjust the volume according to your needs.

It has capacity for a shovel, just enough to move comfortably without carrying too much. If you are a player who does not want to take up a lot of space in your house and simply wants to carry a shovel and a couple of other things inside it, it is a smart option.

Available in several colors, the STREET backpack allows you to choose the one that best suits your personal style.

products.description:

They are comfortable and practical padel shoes for those looking for reliable footwear without having to make the jump to the more expensive ASICS models.  The ASICS GEL DEDICATE 9 CLAY WHITE BLACK are the queens of the Asics Padel mid-range. They are padel shoes with a Clay sole, with a herringbone pattern. This sole offers grip on any court, it is the best for any surface.

With a red design, it combines functionality, resistance and a very striking sports aesthetic. Without a doubt, this new model is one of the most complete and striking in the Wilson 2026 collection. Let's analyze it in its entirety to see everything that this beautiful padel racket bag brings us:

We begin by highlighting its three large main compartments with the capacity to transport up to six paddle tennis rackets, as well as clothing, accessories and everything necessary for training or competitions. The central one is clearly the largest and most spacious, where we can store clothes and everything necessary for good organization.

It also incorporates two additional pockets that we will find on the sides, perfect for storing personal items such as keys, wallet, cell phone or small accessories.

In terms of materials, this WILSON SUPER TOUR RED PADEL BAG RD 2026 PADEL BAG model has been made of 100% high-quality polyester, and offers excellent resistance to daily use and frequent movements.

Its dimensions of 56.5 x 29.2 x 28.6 cm provide a perfect balance between capacity and transport comfort, allowing all equipment to be carried in an orderly and safe manner.

products.title: Nexus Firefight - Nexus
products.description:
NEXUS FIREFIGHT - A teardrop-shaped carbon power racket. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL 

The NEXUS FIREFIGHT is a racket with which your game can shine due to its great power. With a great ball feel, this racket is perfect for all types of intermediate level players, being able to adapt to the conditions of the match at all times.

PLAYER TYPE 

Racquet specially designed for players looking to handle the blow without losing power in each of their blows. Intermediate level.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE 

This racket is characterized by its 3K carbon that provides durability and resistance. Its teardrop/diamond shape helps you have extra power with a more controlled game in the defensive phases of the game. 

Its smooth gloss finish makes its color stand out. Aesthetically it has a modern and striking design. Features a combination of glossy black with neon yellow and white details

PLAY STYLE

The NEXUS FIREFIGHT is designed for a balanced playstyle, albeit with a bias towards power.
